f131aa01461807c64ffb9501.text: Bnberry is transforming the $87 billion travel tech industry by changing how hotels and resorts connect with guests worldwide. We’re building DBS — a new kind of product that hotels adopt as a B2B SaaS business tool, and that travelers experience directly as a consumer-facing hotel booking journey. This is not a Product Owner or delivery-management role focused on writing tickets and managing developers. Your mandate is to own DBS end-to-end, connecting three product areas that most companies keep separate: the guest-facing booking experience, the hotel-facing workflows and business value, and how travelers discover hotels through search and AI tools. What You’ll Own The consumer-facing booking journey — including the logic behind it: availability, rates, cancellation policies, and how PMS/CRS or booking-engine integrations shape what the guest sees Hotel-facing workflows tied to DBS: onboarding, reporting, and adoption The product capabilities that help hotels improve and measure visibility across search engines and AI discovery tools, in partnership with Marketing and relevant specialists Booking-funnel performance and conversion The link between guest experience and measurable hotel business value What You’ll Do Define product vision and roadmap for DBS, connecting guest booking UX, hotel workflows, and AI discovery into one coherent product Own the booking journey end-to-end — identify friction in calendars, date selection, room/rate selection, checkout, and confirmation, and understand how availability, rates, cancellation policies, and PMS/CRS or booking-engine integrations affect what the guest experiences; work with Engineering on dependencies and failure cases Translate hotel onboarding, reporting, and adoption needs into product decisions that show measurable business value to hotel customers Own the product capabilities behind search and AI/GEO visibility — partner with Marketing and relevant specialists on execution, while building enough SEO/GEO literacy to identify and prioritize the right product bets Interview hoteliers and travelers and run usability tests; translate qualitative and quantitative findings into clear priorities Define success metrics before building, and use experiment results to guide iteration Work closely with Design and Engineering through detailed user journeys, making trade-offs and shipping in small, practical iterations Align Engineering, Design, Sales, and Customer Success around DBS priorities, and take responsibility for product outcomes Requirements 3+ years of product management experience owning customer-facing products, including relevant experience in hospitality technology or travel booking Relevant, demonstrable connection to the US market Hands-on customer research skills — hotelier and traveler interviews, usability testing, and translating findings into clear priorities Strong analytical and experimentation skills — diagnosing booking-funnel friction, testing improvements, and measuring booking conversion, hotel adoption, and retention Comfortable working through detailed user journeys with Design and Engineering, making trade-offs, and shipping in small iterations Able to operate independently with ambiguity, prioritize by customer and business value, and align Engineering, Design, Sales, and Customer Success What We’re Looking For: Industry-Grounded — You’ve worked in hotel technology, B2B hospitality platforms, or a B2C travel product with an actual booking journey. Deep exposure to hotel distribution systems is a plus, not a prerequisite — strong B2C travel/booking experience counts too. US Market Fluent — You have demonstrable familiarity with US hotels or travel customers, whether through working with them directly or through living and studying in the US combined with hospitality experience. Booking UX Owner — You understand the details of a booking flow — calendars, date selection, room and rate choice, checkout, confirmation — and the logic behind it: availability, rates, cancellation policies, and PMS/CRS or booking-engine integrations. You can spot friction before a customer complains about it. Fluent in Both Guest and Hotel — You’re as comfortable reasoning about a traveler’s booking journey as you are about a hotelier’s onboarding, adoption, and ROI. Fast Learner on AI/SEO — You understand how travelers discover hotels through search and AI tools, and can pick up emerging SEO/GEO capabilities quickly enough to know which product bets are worth making — without needing to personally execute SEO. Success Metrics Examples include: booking conversion rate, hotel adoption of DBS, feature adoption, booking-funnel completion, search and AI/GEO visibility for hotels on DBS, customer and hotelier satisfaction, and retention. Important Clarification This role is not a traditional Product Owner responsible primarily for backlog management and task assignment. The focus is on owning DBS as a genuinely new product category — one that has to work as a business tool for hotels and as a booking experience travelers actually use. dfbdfe61729407d50cb8c91a.title: Cost Allocation Architect / Business Analyst (Pooling)
dfbdfe61729407d50cb8c91a.text: Trax Inc. provides cloud-based solutions and services to automate and manage freight invoice auditing and payment processing for buyers and sellers of logistics services. The Trax platform enables companies to optimize supply chain performance through greater visibility into their logistics ecosystem and predictive analytics based on over one billion logistics transactions from all industries, modes, and countries. Trax operates on a global scale with offices in the U.S., Latin America, Asia and Europe. About the Role: The Cost Allocation Architect is a specialized technical consultant within the Professional Services organization responsible for designing, developing, and testing the business rules that enable clients to accurately assign and report logistics invoice costs from our platform to their internal Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) or other financial systems. This role sits at the intersection of logistics domain expertise, financial data modeling, enterprise systems integration, and business analysis — translating complex client cost structures and requirements into precise, auditable allocation logic and clear functional designs. This role reports directly to the Manager of Client Enablement in Professional Services. Core Responsibilities Requirements & discovery: Lead discovery and requirements-elicitation workshops with client finance, supply chain, and IT stakeholders to understand cost allocation policies, chart of accounts structure, cost center hierarchies, and ERP data models, and to gather business and functional requirements. Document current-state (as-is) and future-state (to-be) business processes, and translate stakeholder input into clear, testable requirements specifications. Solution design: Design end-to-end cost allocation architectures that map logistics invoice charges — including freight, accessorial fees, fuel surcharges, and duty/tax components — to the appropriate client GL accounts, cost centers, or profit centers. QA Analysis: Perform QA testing and error analysis on agent generated business rules logic to assure accuracy and proper execution while documenting improvement opportunities in agent development knowledge. Aide in the configuration and develop business rules within our platform to automate the routing, splitting, and apportionment of invoice costs according to client-defined allocation logic and business policies. Gap analysis: Conduct gap analyses between current-state client processes and platform capabilities, identifying process changes, workarounds, or enhancement requests needed to close gaps. Design and execute comprehensive testing plans — including unit, integration, and user acceptance testing (UAT) — to validate that allocation rules produce accurate, expected outputs across all invoice scenarios. Develop and maintain detailed functional design documents, data mapping specifications, requirements traceability, and allocation rule libraries to support client sign-off, change control, and long-term maintainability. Enhancement backlog & delivery: Partner with Product and Engineering to prioritize platform enhancement requests, write user stories and acceptance criteria, and validate delivered functionality against documented requirements. Collaborate with client ERP teams (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, etc.) to validate that cost data exported from our platform integrates cleanly into downstream financial workflows and reporting structures. Identify and resolve data quality issues, edge cases, and exception scenarios in invoice processing that could result in allocation errors or ERP posting failures. Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) on cost allocation best practices, advising clients on rule design trade-offs and helping them align logistics cost visibility with broader finance and reporting objectives. Change management & enablement: Support client change management and end-user adoption by developing process documentation, training materials, and communication plans for new allocation workflows. Support post-go-live stabilization by monitoring allocation accuracy, triaging discrepancies, and implementing rule enhancements as client business needs evolve. Contribute to internal knowledge bases, reusable rule templates, and delivery accelerators that improve PS efficiency and consistency across client engagements. Logistics & freight finance: Deep understanding of freight invoice structures, charge types, carrier billing, and accessorial fees. ERP financial data modeling: Working knowledge of GL structures, cost centers, profit centers, and posting logic in SAP, Oracle, or similar ERPs. Business rules design: Ability to translate complex, multi-variable allocation policies into structured, testable rule logic. Business analysis: Proficient in requirements elicitation techniques (interviews, workshops, document analysis), writing user stories/use cases and acceptance criteria, and producing BRDs/FRDs. Process modeling: Ability to create current- and future-state process flows (e.g., BPMN, swimlane diagrams) to support solution design, gap analysis, and client alignment. Testing & QA: Designing and executing test plans covering edge cases, exception handling, and UAT for financial data flows. Data analysis: Proficiency in SQL or Excel to analyze invoice data sets, validate outputs, and troubleshoot allocation discrepancies. Systems integration: Understanding of data exchange formats (EDI, flat file, API/XML) used to transfer cost data between platforms and ERPs. Client facilitation: Ability to lead structured discovery and requirements sessions and communicate technical design decisions to finance and IT audiences. Technical documentation: Producing clear functional specs, data mapping documents, requirements artifacts, and rule design documentation for client sign-off and internal reuse. Qualifications Experience: 4+ years in a technical consulting, implementation, business analyst, or requirements management role within logistics, supply chain, or freight audit and payment. aeb62c8dede5aa870498510e.title: Product Manager
aeb62c8dede5aa870498510e.text: Sift Healthcare is building AI that makes healthcare payments work better for everyone, and we’re looking for a Product Manager to help bring our RevProtect solutions to a fast-growing market. Reporting to the Director of Product Management, you’ll work with Sift‘s Product, Data Science and Data Engineering teams to turn our AI strategy into products that deliver real value for health system clients. This is a role for someone who can set direction and stay close to the build. You’re an established product manager who has shipped software people rely on, and you’re energized by hard, meaningful problems. You bring working knowledge of revenue cycle management, ideally covering pre-claim and denial management workflows, and you’re comfortable translating messy user needs into clear, high-impact solutions. In this role, you’ll own the product development process end-to-end, defining features and writing the user stories that capture what our customers actually need. RESPONSIBILITIES Define and Communicate the Product Vision: Partner with leadership to shape and communicate the strategy and roadmap for our AI/ML clinical documentation improvement solutions, keeping it aligned with client needs and business goals. Translate Product Vision into Solutions: Own the specification process, producing clear and complete documentation that turns product vision into solutions that generate value. Own the Product Backlog: Maintain a prioritized backlog of clearly articulated user stories and features that deliver real value to clients. Lead the Development Process: Guide the team through the full product lifecycle, from ideation to launch, grounded in agile best practices—and keep looking for ways to move faster and work smarter. Deliver High-Quality Work: Own the quality of what ships and hold the team to a high bar. Build With the Technical Team: Work hand-in-hand with data scientists and engineers—in the details of the model and the architecture, not just the requirements—to ship high-quality, scalable solutions. Ensure Seamless Collaboration: Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders so we consistently exceed expectations. Monitor and Measure Success: Track progress within our agile framework, surface and mitigate risks early, and keep improving how the team works. QUALIFICATIONS 5+ years of product management experience in a software environment, with a proven track record of shipping products Strong technical fundamentals and genuine comfort working alongside engineers on how software gets built A bias for execution—you like to roll up your sleeves and get things done Working knowledge of hospital and professional billing workflows, and the provider reimbursement process—ideally spanning pre-claim requirements through final payment—gained in a healthcare setting or an RCM-focused HIT company Experience with analytics, SaaS, or data-driven solutions in a regulated or healthcare setting Familiarity with machine learning and AI concepts Familiarity with APIs and third-party integrations Solid grounding in agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and hands-on experience working with agile teams Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to make technical concepts clear to audiences of varying levels and experience Strong stakeholder management—you can facilitate, negotiate, and bring people along Strong analytical instincts—you can break down a complex problem, pinpoint the real user need, and design a creative solution Ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup, adapt quickly as things change, and stay curious about where AI/ML and healthcare are headed. Bachelor’s degree required; Business or Computer Science preferred COMPENSATION Compensation will be based on skills, experience and performance. In addition to a base salary, this position is eligible for significant performance bonuses and benefits. ABOUT SIFT HEALTHCARE Sift is a data science company working to improve payments operations and outcomes in the healthcare industry. Sift equips healthcare organizations to fully leverage their payments data to work smarter, protect their margins, and accelerate cash flow. Large health systems, leading HCIT vendors, payers, and outsourced revenue management agencies use Sift's Payments Intelligence Platform, ML integrations, and advanced analytics to optimize payment outcomes and enable data-driven decision-making within the revenue cycle. We are a growing and dynamic team that is serious about the application of technology to healthcare. Based in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, Sift is thriving and looking for motivated team members who will help shape our culture. Sift offers competitive salaries and benefits. Learn more about Sift at www.sifthealthcare.com. Originally posted on Himalayas

e3752ea9a3a65c1f0f88d4a6.text: About the Job As Product Manager, Homeowner & Partner Experience, you will own day-to-day product management for Splitero 's consumer-facing surfaces. Reporting to the Director of Product, Homeowner & Partner Experience, your portfolio is the homeowner journey: the acquisition funnel, application experience, homeowner portal, and post-origination experience. You'll work in a tight triad with product design and a dedicated product engineering team, running discovery, writing specs, and shipping conversion-driving improvements on a product where the funnel is the core business. This posting covers two openings with the same title, level, and responsibilities. One Product Manager will own our retail channel: the homeowner-facing funnel, application, and portal. The other will own our wholesale channel: building for the brokers and loan officers who bring homeowners to Splitero , with meaningful early user research and implementation. Both report to the Director of Product, Homeowner & Partner Experience. Channel preference will be considered based on candidate experience and interest. At Splitero , we move fast, and the ideal candidate thrives in that environment. You are someone with strong growth instincts and real craft, hungry to own a product end-to-end, and paired with a director who knows the domain deeply and will invest in your development both as an individual and within the product space. Responsibilities: Product Execution & Delivery Own the bi-weekly sprint planning process and engineering delivery visibility. You lead stand-ups as the team's main point of contact for workload, in collaboration with engineering leaders. Own specs, backlog, and sprint-level product decisions across the homeowner funnel, portal, and post-close experience. Ship with the product engineering and design team in a tight build-measure-learn loop. Own acceptance criteria and launch coordination for homeowner-facing releases, including instrumentation as the definition of done. Conversion & Experimentation Run the experimentation cadence on the acquisition funnel: hypotheses, tests, and analysis in partnership with Analytics, Marketing, and technical team leads Diagnose drop-off and friction across the application journey and prioritize fixes by conversion impact Support new-state launches, including eligibility, disclosures, and state-specific flow variations, in collaboration with legal and compliance. Discovery & Customer Insight Talk to homeowners and homeowner-facing teammates to run a discovery that feeds the roadmap with real customer problems. Partner with design on usability work and with the Product Operations Manager on field feedback from operations. Represent the homeowner's perspective in trade-off conversations while balancing down-funnel operational impact. Reporting Structure: Reports to the Director of Product, Homeowner & Partner Experience. No direct reports; works in a triad with Product Design and the product engineering team. About You 4 - 6 years in product management with consumer-facing product experience. Direct experience planning and coordinating engineering sprints; providing clear visibility of deliverables in collaboration with engineering leadership. Demonstrated conversion or growth work within a consumer-facing product. You have a deep understanding of current product support needs and can anticipate future product growth opportunities. Experience with measurable product testing. You've run experiments on a funnel and can talk about what you learned, not just what you shipped. Comfortable with product analytics. You can self-serve funnel data, define events, and read an experiment honestly while also knowing how to ask for more advanced reporting. Strong collaboration instincts with design and engineering; you make the collaboration across disciplines work well Clear written communicator — your specs are the reason things get built right. Track record at a startup or growth-stage company, or clear hunger for that pace. Preferred: Experience in fintech, consumer lending, or another regulated consumer product — application flows, disclosures, KYC-adjacent journeys Experience with products serving major life-financial decisions, where trust and clarity drive conversion The salary range for this position is $130,000 - $160,000. Within the range, individual pay is determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. About Us Millions of homeowners in today’s economy are sitting on substantial home equity they are unable to access due to rising interest rates and strict qualification requirements of traditional lenders. That means millions of homeowners can’t convert their hard-earned equity into cash to pay off debt, start a home renovation, or pad their retirement to better their lives. Splitero co-founders Michael Gifford and David Zvaifler witnessed the problem firsthand throughout their real estate careers. They set out to create a win-win product that could help those homeowners access their home equity but not make monthly payments like traditional financing options. And thus, Splitero was born. As part of our team, you will join our quest to revolutionize the real estate industry while helping families in need. We offer a suite of benefits designed to help you thrive in all areas of life. We believe in celebrating our successes, doing the right thing, and helping each other so we grow as a team and as individuals. Generous Resources - We want to ensure you are set up to do your best work. In addition to a solid tech stack, and access to any WeWork location, you will receive a monthly cell and internet stipend. Premium Healthcare - We offer comprehensive healthcare plans for you and your family, which employees are eligible for on their first day. Flexible PTO and Parental Leave - We offer a generous PTO and encourage employees to take time off to recharge. We're proud to offer a parental leave policy that allows you to welcome your new addition without worry. We are a workforce composed of individuals with diverse backgrounds, abilities, minds, and identities. In keeping with our commitment to inclusion, we will ensure that people with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. 6e625c361bd04b2a75e49447.text: Headquarters: United States, Remote Job Title: Financial Analyst Location: United State, REMOTE Clari + Salesloft are building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth. With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate. Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future. At Clari + Salesloft, our Financial Analyst will be pivotal to our company’s success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing Finance team and will be a critical partner in scaling the company by building key business relationships across the organization. We believe that the most successful SaaS businesses rely on agile, data-driven finance partners who look beyond budget variances to ensure our R&D investments directly fuel platform innovation and growth. On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for serving as the dedicated finance partner to our Research & Development (Product & Engineering) organization alongside our FP&A leadership. Specifically, you will: Lead R&D Financial Partnering: Serve as the dedicated finance partner to Product & Engineering leadership, evaluating unit-level economics, engineering headcount, and investment KPIs that drive our product roadmap. Drive Executive Reporting: Prepare monthly and quarterly management reporting—analyzing financial results, tracking key trends, and communicating business risks and insights to senior leadership. Leverage Modern Tech & AI: Utilize Pigment as our core FP&A planning platform and Claude AI to accelerate data analysis, reporting, and scenario modeling to automate finance workflows. Execute Business Case & Strategic Modeling: Perform ad-hoc business case evaluations and scenario analyses to guide strategic technology initiatives and investment decisions. Support Financial Operations: Partner with Accounting during the month-end close process to complete variance analysis and assist with R&D financial reporting. In addition to working with amazing colleagues who exemplify our ‘team over self’ core value, you will also have the opportunity to work directly across different management levels to solve complex financial challenges and shape how we scale a world-class revenue platform. You will have an opportunity to make a difference. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR: We are seeking a self-motivated, tech-savvy, and highly analytical problem solver who is passionate about making an impact. You are an independent thinker with an eye for process improvement, comfortable navigating fast-paced environments, and eager to leverage cutting-edge tools to optimize financial strategy for software engineering teams. If you’re looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming a Financial Analyst is the career path for you! THE TEAM: Our Clari + Salesloft Finance team is comprised of seasoned and up-and-coming finance and analytics professionals. The Finance team consists of results-oriented SaaS professionals with a strong analytical mindset and a passion for strategic problem solving. The team members share a few common traits: they are collaborative, highly curious, detail-oriented, and focused on helping the company scale cleanly. THE SKILL SET: 2 to 3 years of experience in FP&A, Sales Operations, or quantitative financial analysis roles within a high-growth tech or B2B SaaS environment. b2a8a9f491d4a9af1de01478.text: Headquarters: Remote URL: https://redditinc.com/ Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . About the Role Reddit is looking for a Group Product Manager to lead the product management of our Finance SaaS portfolio, our systems that run treasury, planning, procure-to-pay, record-to-report, quote-to-cash, payroll, and equity. This is a player-coach role: you'll coach and manage a small team of SaaS product managers who each own a domain of Finance's application stack, while personally owning your own set of applications as a player. This role serves as the orchestration layer for Finance and AI Transformation, requiring you to advise senior executives, influence strategic direction, and navigate complex matrixed environments to translate high-level strategy into measurable business outcomes. You set the product vision and roadmap across the Finance SaaS landscape, decide what gets built and bought, drive adoption, and own the vendor relationships that underpin the stack. You partner closely with the Enterprise Architecture & Engineering team. They own how systems are built and integrated; you own what we build, why, and when. You will be at the forefront of our AI-first finance strategy, championing the next generation of intelligent automation to redefine efficiency and scalability across our global operations. If you're energized by translating complex finance processes into clean, well-run systems, thrive at the seam between business and technology, and want to both lead a team and stay close to the product yourself, this role is for you. What You'll Do Product Strategy & Portfolio Ownership Own the end-to-end product vision and multi-quarter roadmap for Reddit's Finance SaaS portfolio across P2P, R2R, QTC, payroll & equity, and treasury/investments/EPM. As the lead for Finance & AI Transformation, you are the catalyst for shifting Reddit’s finance teams from manual processes to AI-enabled workflows. This includes championing a “finance engineer” mindset, proactively identifying AI use cases for close automation and anomaly detection, and fostering a culture where data-driven innovation is embedded in our operating model. Translate Finance's priorities (e.g., close acceleration, scalability, public-company rigor, M&A) into a sequenced, defensible roadmap. Lead build-vs-buy and vendor selection decisions; serve as the product voice in Finance technology investments alongside the Enterprise Architect. Define and enforce a consistent product operating model across the team: intake, prioritization, release management, change management, and adoption measurement. Identify opportunities to improve Finance processes through AI-enabled workflows, reconciliations, anomaly detection, approval copilots, and close automation. Drive roadmap prioritization using measurable outcomes such as close cycle reduction, automation rates, SOX compliance effectiveness, and Finance productivity improvements. Establish a single, transparent demand pipeline so Finance stakeholders can see what's planned, in flight, and shipped. Assess the end-to-end finance processes to identify manual workflows, process gaps, control weaknesses, data quality issues, and opportunities to improve and enable AI-powered solutions.. Create a cross-functional decision framework for Finance capabilities, including clear ownership, intake, prioritization, readiness criteria, and business sign-off. Identify, design, and launch new features and system capabilities that enhance user efficiency while driving incremental value for the business. Partner with finance leadership to enable AI use across teams, fundamentally shifting the organization toward a "finance engineer" mindset where finance teams are empowered to build, automate, and innovate within our systems. Drive end-to-end finance transformation initiatives across Quote-to-Cash (QTC), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Record-to-Report (R2R), and Hire-to-Retire (H2R), ensuring alignment between process improvements and long-term scalability. Strategic Orchestration & Influence Advise senior Finance and Tech leadership on roadmap trade-offs, balancing speed, risk, and long-term impact. Navigate organizational dynamics to secure alignment across Finance, Tech, and Business partners. Promote harmony between internal teams and external integration partners by resolving bottlenecks and managing cross-functional dependencies. Lead a rigorous diligence program to evaluate and optimize system performance, workflows, and adoption metrics to strengthen operational quality. Team Leadership Directly manage a team of SaaS product managers, each owning a Finance domain (P2P & R2R, QTC, Payroll & Equity). Set clear direction and priorities for each domain, and create space for deep, high-quality product work. Develop your team's craft through roadmap review, stakeholder coaching, and regular 1:1s focused on growth. Serve as an escalation point and thought partner when your PMs hit ambiguity, contention over priorities, or cross-functional friction. Build the bench: define the team's coverage model, identify gaps, and grow the function as Finance scales. Hands-On Product Ownership: Maintain direct ownership over a specific set of applications, leading their product roadmaps and managing key stakeholder relationships. This isn't a purely managerial role: you'll run intake, prioritize enhancements, manage releases, and partner directly with Finance and the Eng team to deliver in your own portfolio. Stay close enough to the work to credibly coach your team and make sharp product tradeoffs. Vendor and Demand Management Own Finance SaaS vendor relationships at the portfolio level: renewals, SLAs, roadmap influence, escalations, and spend rationalization. Bring a demand-management mindset to intake; help Finance stakeholders articulate needs, size effort, and sequence work effectively rather than absorbing every request. Partner with Procurement and Finance leadership on tooling spend, contract timing, and consolidation opportunities. Maintain a clear view of total cost of ownership and license utilization across the stack. Stakeholder Partnership Act as the primary product liaison for Finance leadership, translating business requirements into roadmap decisions and communicating tradeoffs clearly. Partner with FP&A, Technical Accounting, Revenue, Treasury, Payroll, and Finance Operations to understand pain points and proactively surface system improvements. Work hand-in-glove with the Enterprise Architect and Engineering team to land integrations, data quality, and technical delivery against the product roadmap. Support M&A activity (e.g., systems due diligence, gap analysis, integration sequencing, and adoption planning for acquired entities). What We're Looking For 8+ years in product management, business/finance systems, or finance transformation, including 2+ years directly managing people. Demonstrated ownership of Finance SaaS platforms across multiple domains (ERP, EPM/CPM, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, treasury, or payroll). Track record of building and running a product/intake operating model: roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, release and change management. Strong vendor management chops: selection, renewals, SLAs, and influencing vendor roadmaps Prior people management experience, with a track record of developing PM or systems-analyst talent. Strong ability to operate across abstraction levels: comfortable in an executive roadmap discussion and in the configuration details of a specific platform. Excellent communication skills: you can frame a portfolio strategy for a CFO and a sprint priority for an engineer in the same afternoon. Strong knowledge of financial controls, audit readiness, SOX requirements, data quality, and compliance impacts. Experience defining close transformation roadmaps, reconciliation strategies, reporting readiness plans, and UAT strategies. Proven success scaling products and owning business outcomes in high-growth, complex environments. Bonus Points Experience at a high-growth public technology company Familiarity with Reddit's existing Finance tech stack (NetSuite, Workato, Adaptive, Zip, Coupa, Ramp, Workday, Salesforce or comparable) or similar environments Familiarity with advertising platforms and transformation initiatives spanning quote-to-cash or procure-to-pay workflows Experience supporting M&A workstreams (diligence, integration, cutover) Exposure to SOX compliance considerations in finance systems Background partnering with Corporate Engineering or shared-services models Why This Role, Why Reddit Reddit's Finance organization is scaling rapidly through organic growth, internal investments, and increasing public-company rigor. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how Finance technology evolves at a consequential moment: owning the product direction for a portfolio that touches every corner of the company, leading a team, and keeping your own hands on the work. You'll have the autonomy to set direction, the team support to execute, and the organizational access to make product decisions that stick. 2fd0a80309083b4c4e016811.text: Responsibilities Peraton 's Department of the Interior (DOI), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), and NOAA's National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS) have identified a critical gap in the federal government's ability to conduct comprehensive Endangered Species Act (ESA) research. While FWS operates an authoritative web-based platform for managing data for terrestrial and freshwater species, it does not currently include NMFS marine and anadromous species data forcing agencies to rely on separate, manual processes. This program closes that gap by integrating marine and anadromous species data into the existing FWS platform, creating a single, unified experience for all ESA-listed species. Peraton is seeking a Business Analyst with deep expertise in NOAA Fisheries (the National Marine Fisheries Service, the federal agency within NOAA responsible for managing and conserving U.S. marine resources) data systems and consultation processes to serve as the dedicated NOAA Fisheries liaison on a federal data integration program. You will ensure NOAA Fisheries requirements are accurately captured, data systems are properly documented, and all required approvals are obtained throughout the project. Work Location: Remote Roles and Responsibilities Serve as the dedicated SME for NOAA Fisheries business processes, data systems, and stakeholder coordination Document NOAA Fisheries-specific consultation requirements including marine and anadromous species regulatory requirements, Critical Habitat designations, and listing status standards Elicit and document NOAA Fisheries data system requirements including authoritative source identification, data access pathways, refresh cadences, and data stewardship contacts Coordinate with NOAA Fisheries SMEs to obtain approval on schema harmonization decisions and ensure all data modifications are authorized Facilitate iterative range map review cycles with NOAA Fisheries SMEs and coordinate input on map accuracy and completeness Support development of NOAA Fisheries-specific decision logic and template content requirements Coordinate NOAA Fisheries co-signature on the ESA Section 7 Compliance Validation Checklist Facilitate NOAA Fisheries partner office participation in pilot consultation workflows Serve as the primary liaison between the Peraton team and NOAA Fisheries Qualifications Basic Qualifications Bachelors degree and 8 years professional experience or a Masters degree and 6 years professional experience or an Associates degree and 10 years professional experience; or a high school diploma/equivalent and 14 years’ professional experience. U.S. Citizenship required; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance Demonstrated years of experience in business analysis or program support on federal environmental or marine science programs Strong understanding of ESA Section 7 consultation processes for marine and anadromous species Experience facilitating government stakeholder reviews and obtaining formal approvals Excellent written communication skills; experience producing government-facing documentation Preferred Qualifications Direct experience working with or supporting NOAA Fisheries operations or data systems Direct experience with NOAA Fisheries authoritative data systems or marine species databases Experience coordinating multi-agency deliverable approvals (FWS + NOAA Fisheries) Familiarity with federal data governance standards and OCIO-authorized data pathways CBAP or equivalent BA certification Active Public Trust Clearance Peraton Overview Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure. 5add3b5973119f814081f104.title: Financial Analyst
5add3b5973119f814081f104.text: Type: Full-Time Location: Orange County, CA preferred, open to Remote or Hybrid Reports to: VP of Finance ABOUT EJAM eJam is a consumer products company that has built, scaled, and exited multiple brands. Our portfolio includes category leaders ranked at the top of Amazon, carried in major retailers nationwide, and sold across DTC, marketplaces, and every channel in between. We're not a startup hoping something works. We're a team that has done it repeatedly: taken products from zero to eight figures, landed them on retail shelves nationwide, and built real brands that consumers love. We operate like a holding company with the speed of a startup: small teams with real ownership and accountability. This is the place where you'll see the entire machine, sourcing, product development, packaging, manufacturing, compliance, marketing, marketplace strategy, retail, all under one roof. If you want to be a part of building and shipping consumer products at scale, there is no better place than this. ABOUT THE ROLE This is a combined FP&A and treasury role. You will own the reporting and models leadership uses to run the business, and you will own the cash side of the house, the daily position, the short term forecast and the reporting that supports our credit facilities. It is a broad seat with real visibility, reporting directly to the VP of Finance and working alongside the Accounting Supervisor and the brand leads. If you want to see how the money is made and how it moves, in one role, this is that job. WHAT YOU WILL DO Financial planning and analysis Prepare and refresh recurring management reporting, including monthly P&L packages, KPI dashboards and brand level performance summaries. Build and maintain financial models in Excel covering revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, operating expense and headcount. Perform budget versus actual and period over period variance analysis, and write clear commentary explaining what actually drove the result. Support the annual budget and the rolling forecast, gathering and challenging inputs from brand and functional owners. Analyze product, channel and brand profitability, combining COGS and inventory data from Cin7 with financials from QuickBooks Online. Track marketing efficiency alongside the brand teams, connecting spend to contribution margin rather than revenue alone. Analyze vendor and operating spend trends in Ramp, and flag where cost is running ahead of plan early enough to act. Partner with accounting so reporting ties to the closed books, and help investigate results that do not look right. Build ad hoc analysis for the VP of Finance and brand leadership, turning messy data into a clear, defensible recommendation. Treasury and cash management Prepare the daily cash on hand and available credit report across all bank accounts, entities and brands. Own the rolling thirteen week cash forecast, updating receipts, disbursements and financing activity as new information arrives. Track expected collections using A/R data from SAI, and expected disbursements using A/P and card data from Ramp. Prepare and route funding transfers between entities and accounts, and monitor balances against target minimums. Reconcile bank activity daily, investigate unidentified deposits, returns and exceptions, and escalate quickly. Support borrowing base reporting, covenant tracking and lender reporting packages under the group's credit facilities. Monitor merchant processor and marketplace settlements, and tie payouts back to the general ledger in QuickBooks Online. Maintain bank administration records, including account documentation, user access and payment approval matrices. Coordinate with payroll so wage, contractor and benefit obligations are funded on time through Deel. Across both Use Claude to accelerate data cleanup, reconciliation, model documentation and first-draft analysis, then verify the output before it goes out. Replace manual steps with repeatable templates, so recurring reporting gets faster and less fragile each cycle. Document what you build, so the report survives a vacation and does not live only in your head. SYSTEMS YOU WILL WORK IN eJam 's systems of record are QuickBooks Online (financials), Ramp (accounts payable and corporate cards), SAI (accounts receivable), Deel (PEO and HRIS) and Cin7 (inventory and product COGS), alongside our bank and lender portals. Microsoft Excel is the everyday modeling and reporting tool, and AI, primarily Claude, is part of how this team works rather than an optional extra. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE First thirty days, you can produce the daily cash and credit report and the monthly management reporting package independently, and you know where each number comes from. First ninety days, you own the rolling thirteen week cash forecast, and your variance commentary is what leadership reads first. First six months, at least two recurring reports run materially faster than they did before you arrived, and you are surfacing issues to the VP of Finance before he has to ask about them. COMPENSATION The salary range for this role is $80,000 to $100,000 per year. a7e75efad6b772653739b9c7.text: Type of Requisition: Regular Clearance Level Must Currently Possess: None Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain: None Public Trust/Other Required: None Job Family: Data Science and Data Engineering Job Qualifications: Skills: Data Analytics, Health Care, Python for Data Analysis, Statistical Analysis Certifications: None Experience: 4 + years of related experience US Citizenship Required: No Job Description: At GDIT, people are our differentiator. Our work depends on a Data Analyst joining our team to support Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services anti-fraud activities. As a Data Analyst supporting the Healthcare Fraud Prevention Partnership (HFPP), you will develop fraud, waste and abuse (FWA) analytics from concept to finished product at the Trusted Third Party (TTP), working against a multi-billion record claims warehouse assembled from dozens of public and private healthcare payers. HFPP Partners and the client bring the questions. You turn them into analytics that identify aberrant billing and hold up to scrutiny. You will engage with healthcare claims and FWA analytics working alongside experienced Subject Matter Experts, and you do need to be genuinely strong with data. ***W ork visa sponsorship will not be provided for this position. This is a remote role. Candidates must reside in the United States. HOW A HEALTHCARE CLAIMS DATA ANALYST WILL MAKE AN IMPACT: Working with a multi-disciplinary team of Data Scientists, Business Intelligence Developers and FWA Subject Matter Experts. Our team is 100% remote and distributed throughout the country. Translating Partner and client requests into specifiable analytic questions, including determining what can and cannot be answered with the data available and raising that early rather than late. Developing FWA analytics end to end, building the analytic logic in SQL and Python against billions of claim records, testing it, and refining it in collaboration with FWA Subject Matter Experts until it identifies something real. Separating genuine aberrancy from patterns fully explained by legitimate clinical practice, coverage policy or claim edits, recognizing that the mundane explanation is usually the correct one and that finding it before a Partner does is part of the work. Documenting methodology, assumptions and data lineage so that each analytic can be reproduced and incorporated into the TTP analytic suite by another team without the original analyst present. Documenting findings and present results to internal stakeholders, and will participate in Partner discussions to clarify analytic requirements. Managing several concurrent requests against firm deadlines within a queue driven by Partner and client demand. WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED: Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or health-related field, or equivalent hands-on experience. 4+ years writing SQL against large relational data, including CTEs, window functions and multi-table joins at scale, with enough performance awareness to understand why a query is slow. Working proficiency in Python for data analysis, producing clean and reproducible analysis code (pandas or equivalent). Demonstrated ability to turn an ambiguous request into a defined analytic question, including recognizing when a question cannot be answered with the data at hand. Experience documenting analytic work such that another person can reproduce it, and evidence of having come up to speed quickly in an unfamiliar data domain. Ability to explain analytic results clearly, in writing and in conversation, to audiences who are not analysts. Accuracy, attention to detail and the organizational discipline to carry several concurrent requests without dropping any. US citizen or Permanent Resident Must be able to obtain/maintain Public Trust DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS: Experience with healthcare claims data (Medicare, Medicaid or commercial) and healthcare coding systems (e.g., ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS, DRG). Exposure to fraud, waste and abuse, program integrity, payment integrity or utilization review work. Experience with Snowflake and SnowSQL, or a comparable cloud data warehouse. Version control (Git) and collaborative code review practices. Familiarity with payer coverage policy (LCDs, NCDs, private carrier medical policies) and common industry claim edits (e.g., NCCI). Experience using Tableau or other data visualization software. WHAT GDIT CAN OFFER YOU: The GDIT HFPP Trusted Third Party is the only data warehouse of its type anywhere, bringing many billions of healthcare claims from dozens of public and private payers together solely for fraud, waste and abuse analytics. The cross-payer visibility it provides exists nowhere else. Direct daily working contact with FWA Subject Matter Experts, Business Intelligence Developers and Data Scientists on a small, fully remote, multi-disciplinary team where analytic work reaches the people who act on it. Competitive pay and benefits, flexible work schedule, collaborative inter-disciplinary environment where the best idea wins. The likely salary range for this position is $76,500 - $103,500. 08048a9ff7c956be9a89fd63.text: Join Axon and be a Force for Good. At Axon , we’re on a mission to Protect Life. Your Impact Business Analysts are trusted advisors who bridge customer vision and technology. In this role, you'll partner with public safety agencies to understand operational needs, design solutions, and configure software that supports mission-critical work. As part of a collaborative, cross-functional deployment team, you'll help deliver successful implementations across an industry leading public safety SaaS platform. Business Analysts follow two tracks; as a consultative customer partner or a technical builder, you'll have opportunities to solve meaningful problems, work directly with customers, and grow with a team whose work directly supports the agencies protecting our communities. Self-starter who thrives with problem-solving and embraces ambiguity. Willingness to join forces and drive company-wide initiatives across multiple departments. 4234ca6830ce448467389340.text: ASRC Federal is a leading government contractor furthering missions in space, public health and defense. As an Alaska Native owned corporation, our work helps secure an enduring future for our shareholders. Join our team and discover why we are a top veteran employer and Certified Great Place to Work™ ASRC Federal is actively seeking a System Analyst to join our team and support defining business and systems requirements for our federal customer. The successful candidate will have a solid understanding of analyst skill tools to elicit business requirements, possess excellent written and oral skills, and be able to define requirements for government systems. Work location: Remote Clearance: The successful candidate is subject to a U.S. Federal Government background investigation and must be able to meet the requirements to hold a position of public trust. Must be a US Citizen. Responsibilities: The successful candidate will work with business sponsors and other relevant stakeholders to define and document the system requirements for complex government software systems. The ability to work with both technical and non-technical audiences is very important, so having a solid understanding of the software development process is key. Principal responsibilities will include but are not limited to: ▪ Performing analysis to support the project managers in defining project scope and objectives, ▪ Facilitating meetings with stakeholders to organize work and priorities; ▪ Analyzing system processes for new and revised business applications; ▪ Eliciting information and functional requirements from product owners and business sponsors through oral and written communication, ▪ Documenting requirements, such as Concept of Operations, Business Case, and Alternatives Analysis style deliverables; ▪ Collecting and documenting preliminary data requirements; ▪ Generate mockups of proposed solutions, presenting mockups and refining requirements; ▪ Interfacing with Enterprise Architecture representatives, team members, and other contractors to ensure compliance with Enterprise Architecture technical guidelines, ▪ Assisting in designing technical specifications for complex, integrated government systems which include numerous feeders crossing agency boundaries; ▪ Performing research, systems analysis, concept, and systems design; ▪ Reviewing and analyzing programming systems underlying code and data structures to support technical and business process requirements; ▪ Documenting architecture decisions and results as part of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) deliverables; ▪ Championing the implementation and usage of SOA architecture, enterprise patterns, and governance processes; ▪ Conducting market analysis of government and commercial systems to identify costs, benefits, and risks of pursing solutions that can support the capabilities and visions identified in the business requirements document(s), business flow, and performance strategy: ▪ Making marketing recommendations based on the data collected; ▪ Tracking and forecasting market trends; and ▪ Explaining why a certain recommendation is in the best interest of the government; ▪ Assisting with development testing. Education and Experience: ▪ A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or related field or equivalent experience is preferred. ▪ A minimum 5 years’ experience software/hardware development efforts. ▪ Candidates without degrees can be considered, providing they have a minimum of 9 years' relative experience. Required Skills and Competencies: ▪ Strong technical writing skills, with the ability to concisely describe business requirements and functional requirements. ▪ Problem-solving and decision-making skills. ▪ Ability to Create required system process deliverable documents. Examples of documents include concept of operations, business case, and alternatives analysis documentation. ▪ Ability to use a variety of software tools for managing requirements, creating diagrams and written documents to communicate with a variety of stakeholders; both technical and non-technical. ▪ Experience using work-related tools and software. Examples of tools include Visio, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Azure, and Jira. ▪ Ability to produce high-quality business requirements documents. Examples of documentation include business requirement specifications (BSR), workflow diagrams, context diagrams, use cases, and user stories. ▪ Possess a solid understanding of user interfaces and most common approaches found in GUIs. ▪ Ability to present requirements findings and mockups for review with sponsors and end users. ▪ Ability to understand formulas used in financial calculations and to describe relevant workflows. ▪ Working knowledge of database systems (SQL Server and Oracle). ▪ Experience with Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) management tools and software, including Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS), Open Source Software (OSS), Software as a Service (SaaS), etc. ▪ Ability to determine how business and systems requirements are managed as components within a SOA framework. ▪ Solid understanding of scalable deployment options (on-premises, cloud, hosted) for custom and COTS software applications. Desired Skills: ▪ Experience working with a wide range of personnel, including business sponsors, product owners, government project managers, development teams, and end users at all levels of the organization. ▪ Familiarity with formalized requirements management frameworks and IT frameworks and processes such as IEEE, ITIL, Scrum, Agile, and Kanban. ▪ Experience with Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) concepts. ▪ Experience developing governance and coordination models. ▪ Market research skills. ▪ Experience with GIS technology and methodology ▪ Familiarity with data modeling concepts ▪ Familiarity with Agile development methodologies. ▪ Familiarity with integrating COTS and custom software as part of an enterprise software solution ▪ Experience with Systems Analysis tasks: ▪ Systems design skills would include UML diagrams, mockups, context diagrams, entity relationship diagrams and object models, ▪ Familiarity with Enterprise Architecture Frameworks such as TOGAF, FEA/DoDAF, or Zachman. ▪ Prior government experience (as a federal employee or contractor) highly desired ▪ Understanding of Federal security families and controls defined in NIST 800-53, rev. 4, FIPS 199, and related security guidance ▪ Prior experience as a web-based software developer We invest in the lives of our employees, both in and out of the workplace, by providing competitive pay and benefits packages. Benefits offered may include health care, dental, vision, life insurance; 401(k); education assistance; paid time off including PTO, holidays, and any other paid leave required by law. The salary offered will depend on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, education, geographic location, internal equity, business needs, and other factors permitted by law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, gender, color, age, sexual orientation, gender identification, national origin, religion, marital status, ancestry, citizenship, disability, protected veteran status, or any other factor prohibited by applicable law. 6c2f11cd5b60bb37876baddb.text: Hi, We’re Franki Going out should feel good, not expensive. Franki helps people discover great restaurants, get cash back just for going, and earn even more for sharing. We're building a smarter way to eat, drink, and explore your city, helping local restaurants thrive and making the experience more rewarding for everyone. We're a fast-moving, high-ownership team that values creativity and execution. You'll work on real problems for local businesses alongside people who care about building useful products. You bring the product judgment and the willingness to do the work. We'd love to hear from you. About the Role Franki is looking for a Product Manager to own our B2B merchant platform end to end. You'll build the products that help hospitality businesses join Franki , manage cashback offers, verify transactions, understand their results, and manage billing. Your focus: turning a better merchant experience into stronger acquisition, retention, and revenue. As Franki 's first dedicated B2B Product Manager, you'll report to the Chief Operating Officer and work directly with Engineering, Design, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and partnerships. This is an individual-contributor role with no direct reports, significant autonomy, and ownership from discovery through delivery and measurement. This is a strategic role for someone who enjoys being hands-on. You'll set the roadmap and write every engineering ticket, own the merchant request and bug queue, join merchant calls, and build or specify the internal tools that make operations more efficient. You'll be as comfortable resolving a merchant issue as deciding what we should build next. What you'll do: Own the B2B roadmap across Franki +, self-serve onboarding, merchant dashboards, analytics, offer management, billing, and POS integrations. Agree on priorities with the COO quarterly and review them monthly. Run discovery with merchants, Sales, and Customer Success. Size problems, make explicit tradeoffs, and turn recurring requests into scalable product improvements. Write product specifications, user stories, every B2B engineering ticket, and testable acceptance criteria. Own the backlog and partner with Design and Engineering on usability, technical scope, and sequencing. Lead releases from acceptance testing through launch, release notes, and Sales and Customer Success enablement. Instrument every launch, measure results, and improve or retire features that miss their intended outcomes. Improve conversion from sign-up to first live offer, reduce product-driven merchant churn, and grow Franki + adoption and revenue per account. Recommend packaging and upgrade improvements; final pricing decisions remain with leadership. Own all product requests routed by Sales and every B2B bug from triage to resolution. Reproduce issues, prioritize by impact, run weekly triage, and set and meet response and resolution service levels with Sales and Customer Success. Join merchant calls as the product voice, including escalations. Diagnose problems, set honest expectations, validate solutions, and follow up in writing with merchants and internal teams. Own the merchant experience for POS connections and transaction verification, including connection status and failure recovery. Work with Engineering and Finance on billing, payment-method management, and related product workflows. Build or specify internal tools, admin experiences, and no-code or AI-assisted automations that reduce manual work and errors. Retain human review for automations touching authentication, payments, account access, or card-linked verification. Partner with the COO and partnerships team on API and partner integrations, from requirements and engineering tickets to launch support, while balancing integration work against the core roadmap. Define metric baselines and report monthly on acquisition, retention, gross merchandise value (GMV), recurring revenue, and operational efficiency, with clear drivers, risks, and recommended actions. You're a good fit if you have... Required: B2B product management experience serving local restaurants or hospitality merchants, such as restaurant technology, hospitality SaaS, or local-merchant platforms. Startup or growth-stage product experience, or 3–5+ years or more of product management experience, with demonstrated ownership of a roadmap through shipped features and measured results. Strong product craft: discovery, problem sizing, prioritization, clear specifications, engineering tickets, acceptance criteria, and release management. You're comfortable working in Jira and Confluence and reviewing Figma prototypes. Experience shipping API, integration, or POS-connected products. You understand REST APIs, webhooks, connection flows, transaction matching, and failure cases such as refunds, voids, and partial payments. Working knowledge of subscription billing, invoicing, payment-method management, and disputes as product experiences, plus the ability to define metrics, analyze funnels and cohorts, and use SQL and dashboards to guide decisions. Direct merchant-facing experience, including difficult conversations and escalations. You understand restaurant operators' day-to-day constraints and can manage request intake, severity, and service levels using tools such as Intercom and Salesforce. Clear written communication and the ability to align Engineering, Design, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance. You explain decisions, raise risks early, and follow through without a coordination layer. A high degree of ownership and comfort balancing long-term priorities with a live merchant queue. You're resourceful with internal tools and automation and know when a workflow needs human review. A bachelor's degree in business, computer science, engineering, economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Bonus points if you have... Experience delivering POS integrations with systems such as Square, Toast, or Clover. Experience with payments integrations or card-linked offers. Experience building loyalty or rewards products. Experience working on multi-sided marketplaces. Experience supporting sales-led and self-serve customer journeys within the same product. Hands-on SQL experience independently investigating funnel, retention, and revenue questions. Why Join Franki ? Be Franki 's first dedicated B2B Product Manager, with ownership of an entire merchant platform rather than a narrow feature area. See the impact of your work in the businesses you serve and in merchant acquisition, retention, and revenue. Work directly with the COO and cross-functional teams, with the autonomy to shape priorities and the responsibility to deliver. Build both customer-facing products and the internal tools that help Franki scale, in a team that values ownership, inclusion, and mutual respect. Perks & Benefits Remote work: Our team works remotely across the US but primarily PST time zone; we travel together several times a year for company kick-offs and mid-year meetings. PTO: 15 days per year, which includes a Franki holiday shutdown between December 25 - 31. Holidays: We recognize 11 public holidays per year. Medical, Dental & Vision : We cover 100% of Medical, Vision, and Dental insurance costs for employees. 401(k) Equipment: Computer & technology equipment applicable to your role. Technology Stipend: $80/mo to help cover home office expenses . Originally posted on Himalayas

19a10f06be99aa92f9b5fe77.text: Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners . We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners. Since launching publicly in September 2023 , Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue , with a clear path to profitability by late 2026 . We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership. Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue) —the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved. Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt. - Mission-critical problems : We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale. - High bar, low ego : Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership. - Speed over comfort : We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results. - Enduring impact : What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses. Team & Locations We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote. Flex Fuels Ambition. The Role We are looking for product owners who are excited to be part of our early story and help us build a category leading company. You will learn quickly, reflect on "the way the world should work", own outcomes, and drive the creation of financial products and experiences to help our customers reach their full potential. You should have a strong sense of ownership and enjoy taking projects from inception to release. As an early employee, you’ll be working with a nimble team of committed and talented employees and having a large, long-term impact on Flex products and culture. We are open to candidates from Canada, Mexico, the United States, Brazil and Colombia. What you'll do Develop and own Flex 's "Growth engine" across "Infinite wedges". Flex acquires customers in many unique ways that meet business owners where they are. We build software to make these experiences extremely unique. You'll own our growth - end to end - for the full "multi-product" experience. Drive the enhancement of financial services and products, including mobile apps, online account management tools, and virtual payment solutions. Continuously improve the user experience and add features to meet changing customer needs. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to identify opportunities within the organization's operational processes. Develop internal financial solutions, such as automated reporting tools, data analytics platforms, and workflow optimization systems, to increase efficiency and streamline operations. Work closely with compliance and legal to ensure that all products adhere to relevant financial regulations and industry standards. Mitigate potential risks through robust product design and implementation. Stay up-to-date with changes in industry regulations and security protocols. Conduct user research and market analysis to understand customer preferences, pain points, and emerging trends. Utilize these insights to inform product development decisions. Partner with engineering throughout the development lifecycle. Provide clear and detailed product requirements, prioritize features, and ensure the timely delivery of high-quality solutions. Implement necessary measures to safeguard customer data and ensure compliance with relevant laws. Utilize data analytics and performance metrics to assess product performance, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions to optimize products. Work closely with customer support teams to address customer inquiries, feedback, and issues related to products. Continuously strive to improve customer satisfaction and retention. Develop and communicate a clear product roadmap and strategy. Align the product vision with the Flex 's overall objectives. What you'll need Can run sprints. Extremely high trajectory and horsepower. Flex is a place for people who want to own outcomes. Proven experience as a Product Owner or similar role at a startup with a focus on financial products. We bring SaaS platform principles to traditional FinTech. Solid knowledge of credit risk assessment, lending processes, and banking operations a nice to have. Familiarity with compliance standards, regulations, and security protocols relevant to the credit and banking sectors a nice to have. Willingness to become an expert is a must. Excellent communication, translation, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills. Analytical mindset with the ability to leverage data and market insights to inform product decisions. Proficiency in using product management tools and platforms to manage the product backlog and track progress. Passion for innovation, customer-centricity, and continuous improvement in product development. What we offer A visionary founding team with elite backgrounds and substantial industry experience. A substantial Series B round, providing ample growth and opportunities. You're still an early employee. Today is still day 1. A culture that supports remote work and values connection through semi-annual offsites. Support from leading Silicon Valley venture capitalists and industry insiders. An attractive compensation package, including comprehensive benefits and perks. Interested? We'd love to hear from you At Flex , we value passion, determination, and honesty. Even if you don't fully match the job specifics, we encourage you to apply. Unusual career paths and unique skills can help you stand out. We believe diversity drives our success. Why Join Us Build something generational — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners. Work on real money, real risk — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale. Solve hard problems — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles. True ownership — Small teams, high trust, real accountability. Founder-level exposure — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors. High bar, high taste — Move fast without cutting corners. Elite peers — People here are builders, not tourists. Real upside — Meaningful equity if you help build something big. Originally posted on Himalayas
