bcf04bdf543998072ec9f272.text: Associate Product Manager Location: Remote Commercial Real Estate ("CRE") is one of the world's largest asset classes, yet the documents that govern it — leases, amendments, and agreements running thousands of pages — remain locked in formats that are slow to read, easy to misinterpret and nearly impossible to act on at scale. The critical terms buried inside these documents define revenue, risk and capital, but even the most sophisticated owners, operators and investors struggle to turn them into intelligence they can trust. Founded in 2018, Prophia transforms the documents that govern commercial real estate into verified intelligence — combining AI-powered extraction with expert human validation to deliver data our customers can rely on. That trusted data helps owners, operators and investors uncover risk, protect capital and make sharper decisions across leasing, acquisitions, asset management and investor reporting. Today Prophia stewards the largest private CRE dataset in the world — more than 648 million square feet across 5,200+ buildings, 200,000+ documents, and nearly 25,000 tenants — and is backed by leading investors including SignalFire and Cercano. We operate as a distributed team, with employees located across the country and hubs in the San Francisco Bay Area and Seattle. About the Role: The Associate Product Manager sits on Prophia 's Product team and reports to the Director of Product Management. This is an early-career product role built for someone who wants to learn (and/or master) the craft end to end in a startup environment. This is a high-exposure, high-ownership role and you will have real responsibility from day one, not just support work. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity and takes initiative without being asked. Primary Responsibilities: Discovery & Research: Lead customer interviews with our ICP to surface pain points and validate product bets Synthesize qualitative and quantitative signals into clear, actionable product briefs Help define and prioritize initiatives across Prophia 's core product areas Execution & Delivery: Write feature specs, user stories and acceptance criteria that give engineering a clear path to ship Own defined work streams end-to-end, tracking status, surfacing blockers, keeping stakeholders aligned Drive features from research through release, including launch readiness and release communications Communication & Alignment: Help maintain and communicate the Now/Next/Later roadmap internally and with customers Prepare materials for leadership updates, conference presentations and external product messaging Partner with Customer Success to make sure new features land well with existing customers Qualifications: 1–3 years of experience in a product role, or in an adjacent role (analyst, engineering, design, data, or customer-facing) with a clear motivation to move into product management Exposure to commercial real estate, property management or asset management workflows Strong written communication, including the ability to turn fuzzy ideas into clear specs and crisp narratives Organized and systematic: you track the details so nothing falls through the cracks Genuine curiosity about AI and how it is reshaping knowledge work and enterprise software Preferred Qualifications: Experience with document-heavy or data extraction products Experience with Yardi or MRI (huge plus!) Familiarity with AI/LLM products or agentic pipelines Track record of running customer interviews and translating findings into product decisions Compensation for this role is comprised of an annual salary ranging between $100,000-$120,000 as well as equity and benefits. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications and experience. Next Steps: If you think we may be a good fit for each other, we encourage you to apply! We will get back to you within a week. If we move forward, here is our typical interview process. A 30 minute phone call with a member of Prophia ’s People Team to understand your high-level background and to discuss logistics and expectations. A 45 minute video call with the hiring manager for the role to dig deeper into your background, relevant skills and early stage startup and/or CRE experience. A virtual final loop! This stage includes 3-4 interviews with other members of the team focused on Prophia ’s company values and how you would demonstrate them if you were to join the organization. We Offer: Competitive salary and equity compensation An amazing team and work environment Comprehensive health, dental and vision care for you and your family Retirement plan (401K) Flexible time off policy and paid holidays Generous paid family, medical and bereavement leave policies Freedom to customize your work and technology set-up as you see fit; flexibility of location --- Prophia is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identify, national origin, veteran or disability status. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire. About Nova Nova 401(k) Associates is a vibrant and growing national third party, non-producing administration firm. We have a nationally recognized sales team allowing us to grow continuously and provide career advancement opportunities for our professionals. What Nova Offers You This position supports a great work-life balance with a 37.5-hour work week, generous PTO, and overtime pay. We also financially support professional designations and offer regular, recurring professional training. We offer a competitive compensation package including medical insurance, dental insurance, disability insurance, life insurance, a 401(k) plan, and an HSA. 971bd648ca162f394ffa3ef2.title: Product Owner/Associate (foreUP)
971bd648ca162f394ffa3ef2.text: Xplor Technologies powers the experiences at the heart of everyday life. Through modern vertical software, embedded payments, and AI-powered capabilities, we help businesses in fitness, recreation, golf and club, field services, laundry, education, and other membership-based and service-based industries simplify operations, uncover insights, and elevate customer and member experiences. We unite popular brands such as Clubessential , foreUP , myFitApp , Vermont Systems , Momence , Exerp , and many more. Product Owner/Associate will work closely with the foreUP product and development teams, as well as with clients and other internal and external stakeholders, to support the direction and strategy for our products. They will be in charge of informing the group of engineers, designer, and QA testers about the product vision, strategy, and direction. They act as the primary line of communication between the business stakeholders and the delivery teams, who will design, build, and test our products. The Product Owner/Associate also will need to be able to communicate to comprehend our business prospects, translate them into a polished and manageable backlog, and manage the team’s deliverables. As AI becomes a bigger part of how we build products, the Product Owner/Associate will also help identify where AI and automation can create real value for our customers, and work closely with engineering and data teams to bring those capabilities to life responsibly. RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES: Serve as Owner of the products; ensure products are meeting and exceeding the needs of external customers and prospects to expand addressable market and reduce/eliminate churn as well as internal stakeholders to allow for ease of implementation and support. Maintain focus on technological trends and competitive landscape to drive innovation. Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation within the product to improve efficiency, personalization, and decision-making for customers and internal users. Own the creation and grooming of the product backlog by writing and refining user stories that support sprint goals and align with product strategy. Serve as the Gatekeeper of the product backlog and primary feedback loop owner regarding product enhancements, issues, bugs and/or tasks related to the products. Escalate and timely communicate issues, related updates, and resolutions to internal stakeholders as appropriate. Share and contribute meaningful ideas to achieve overall product success, while balancing needs of external customers, expansion of addressable market, ease to support and implement, and churn reduction in mind. Coordinate with product leadership, customers, and team to complete research, develop specifications and user stories for the developers that satisfy business requirements and align with the business value. Partner with engineering and data teams to define requirements, success metrics, and guardrails for AI-powered features, and communicate what those capabilities can and can't do to internal stakeholders and customers. Provide timely feedback to internal stakeholders on plan for resolution; as appropriate, identify which bugs or enhancements will be worked and/or will not be prioritized. Play an active role in mitigating impediments impacting successful team completion of Release/Goals; participate in testing and release readiness as required. Assist with configuration and communicate availability of new features in demo environments. Act as the go to person/liaison for answering questions the development team has about business rules and product behaviors, and/or other internal stakeholders regarding the respective products. Assist in Rollout/Management/Feedback gathering where applicable. Assist in reviewing educational and marketing materials pertaining to the product lines. Deliver product releases and assist with release note creation/educational efforts with quick time-to-market and optimal resources. Develop successful launch plans working directly with implementation, project management and support services, marketing, sales, and our customers. Participate (when appropriate) in additional activities to support the education, marketing and/or success of the product such as webinars, shows, monthly/quarterly update meetings, and/or other activities as applicable. Lead/Assist/Participate (as applicable) in all Scrum ceremonies. Perform other responsibilities pertaining to the product, as assigned. QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED: BS/MS degree in Business, Engineering, or related field preferred 3+ years’ work experience as product owner, business analyst or subject matter expert in SaaS software applications preferred Excellent oral and written communicator up, down, across and outside the organization. Strong critical thinking, analytical and data-driven decision-making skills. Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with a strong sense of urgency and accountability Experience with bug/issue/enhancement tracking, project management software Excels in ability to prioritize, influence decisions/decision makers, and handle objections Excellent active listening, negotiation, communication, and presentation skills Ability to manage numerous diverse projects and multi-task with ease Experience with JIRA, Productboard, Pendo, and/or Figma a plus Experience defining or shipping AI-powered product features, or working closely with data science/ML teams, a plus Comfortable evaluating AI tools and vendors, weighing their capabilities and limitations, and translating them into clear customer value Hands-on experience writing AI skills, skill chains, or agentic workflows to streamline day-to-day work such as research, spec writing, and backlog grooming a plus At Xplor, we believe that the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersections of our differences - people of diverse cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you think you do not tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply. Values and Life at Xplor Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day: Find a better way Do the right thing Say it straight Win together Own the outcome If these values sound like you and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor. As an Xplorer, you will be part of a global network of talented colleagues who will support your success. We look for commonalities and shared passions and give people the tools they need to deliver great work and grow at speed. Ready to apply? To start your application, please submit your resume, and we will be in touch as soon as we can. Got questions? You can email us at . Originally posted on Himalayas

f08b5d5f4b37d29787542349.text: Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta ’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. Cresta ’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences. Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta . Cresta is on a mission to turn every customer conversation into a competitive advantage. Our unified platform combines both AI and human intelligence to enable 1. automating conversations with AI Agents and 2. transform their contact centers to discover customer insights. Born from the Stanford AI lab, Cresta 's co-founder and chairman is Sebastian Thrun, the genius behind Google X, Waymo, and Udacity. Differentiated career development: Get hands-on AI product experience building Agentic solutions using a cutting-edge tech stack Access to an accelerated timeline of customer-facing opportunities as an AI thought partner to executives & leadership Rotational opportunities: Launching solutions for mid-market to Fortune 500 companies across different verticals, gaining breadth & depth in industry knowledge and domain expertise Develop multiple functional strengths as a super-generalist: work on projects that give experience across multiple teams, including go-to-market, engineering, product, customer success, and more Investment & mentorship: Mentorship from PMs who have been building GenAI solutions since GPT-2, as well as from Microsoft, TikTok, consulting firms, and start-ups Launching pad for your learning and career, we take that seriously as a company in scoping opportunities What We’re Looking For: You are a pragmatic, results-oriented problem solver who thrives in fast-paced environments and excels at turning ambiguity into execution. What you’ll bring: 2+ years of relevant experience (e.g., Product Management, Consulting, Implementations, Customer / Sales Engineer, Revenue & Sales Analyst, Investment Banking, Founder) Hands-on work style – curiosity with a bias for action. You deliver with urgency and care Comfortable working with ambiguity and learning quickly in a dynamic startup environment Willingness to travel Bonus Points: Previous exposure via clients or projects to the travel & hospitality, healthcare, insurance, and financial industry domains Experience in a startup or high-growth SaaS environment Experience working closely with AI or LLM-first products Technical understanding, systems thinking and exposure to building Agents (not necessarily conversational, personal projects count!) 4dcfc22b8a1634c04ea50821.text: At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world. ​ Job Overview The Data and Devices (D&D) business unit of TE Connectivity has an opportunity for a Product Manager to join the Power product team. This role must collaborate closely cross-functionally with colleagues in Sales, Engineering, Operations, and Marketing to gain alignment and drive the successful execution of the product roadmaps. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more. About the Company: JSI is a leading full-service consulting firm specializing in broadband solutions. For over 60 years, we have provided independent communications service providers with expert financial, engineering, management, operational, regulatory, and strategic guidance. Our extensive industry knowledge and proven track record of success have empowered clients to achieve sustainable growth and profitability. With clients nationwide and a powerful presence in markets across the United States, JSI empowers rural and regional broadband providers to expand, evolve, and excel in a rapidly shifting digital world. Position Overview: As a Junior Financial Analyst , you will support financial reporting, analysis, forecasting, budgeting, and business performance management while working closely with Finance leadership, business leaders, and the CFO. This role will have regular exposure to senior leadership and will play an important role in helping JSI better understand and manage its financial performance. This is an opportunity for an analytical, highly motivated finance professional who wants to take on meaningful responsibility and have a direct impact on a growing organization. We are looking for someone who is comfortable operating in a less structured, entrepreneurial environment and is excited by the opportunity to build processes rather than simply follow established ones. The successful candidate will bring curiosity, initiative, strong analytical skills, and a willingness to identify opportunities for improvement and take ownership of solutions. Responsibilities Financial Analysis & Reporting Prepare recurring financial reports, dashboards, and analyses for Finance and business leadership. Analyze revenue, expenses, profitability, utilization, and other key financial metrics. Assist with monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting processes. Research and explain variances between actual results, budgets, and forecasts. Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities through analysis of financial and operational data. Support the preparation of management presentations and financial summaries. Provide financial analysis and insights directly to business leaders and the CFO. Budgeting & Forecasting Assist with annual budgeting and periodic forecasting processes. Maintain financial models, forecasts, and supporting schedules. Collect and validate financial information from various departments and business units. Help track performance against budgets and forecasts and communicate significant variances. Support scenario analysis and ad hoc financial modeling. Work with business leaders to understand financial drivers and develop accurate forecasts. Project & Business Financial Support Assist with analyzing project, client, and business-unit financial performance. Monitor revenue, costs, margins, utilization, and other financial indicators. Partner with business leaders to provide meaningful financial information and reporting. Help identify potential billing, revenue, expense, or profitability issues. Analyze staffing, utilization, and other operational metrics that impact financial performance. Develop analysis that helps leadership make informed business decisions. Process Development & Improvement Help build and improve financial processes, reporting tools, and procedures as JSI continues to grow. Identify gaps in existing processes and recommend practical solutions. Develop and maintain financial models, templates, and reporting methodologies. Look for opportunities to automate or streamline recurring financial analyses. Help establish greater consistency and visibility across financial reporting. Take ownership of projects and processes rather than waiting for highly structured direction. Conduct research and prepare ad hoc financial analyses for leadership. Provide analytical support to the CFO and Finance team on special projects and strategic initiatives. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build effective working relationships with business leaders, Finance leadership, and the CFO. Ability to work independently in a remote environment while remaining highly collaborative. Demonstrated initiative, curiosity, and willingness to take ownership. Preferred: Experience working in a private equity-backed organization or familiarity with the financial reporting and performance expectations of a private equity environment. Experience in managed services, professional services, consulting, technology, or telecommunications . 976673dda777e44deec118ab.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
976673dda777e44deec118ab.text: Job Description – Business Intelligence Analyst (Financial Services/AEC) Division / Department: Business Operations / FP&A (Biz Ops / RevOps) Reports to (position): Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis (Biz Ops / RevOps) Level / Grade: Analyst Location: Remote (US) Employment Type: Full Time, Exempt Work Conditions: Remote Office Environment Travel: Minimal Telecommute: Yes Minimum Educational Req: Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, business, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. Years of Experience: 2-4 years of experience in a data, analytics, BI, or FP&A support role; strong internships or academic projects count. Position Summary The Business Intelligence Analyst sits on the FP&A team but serves the entire organization. You will query data from our data lake, turn it into clean and trustworthy reports and dashboards, analyze the data and deliver insight that helps leaders across the business make better decisions. This is a hands-on, data-focused/FP&A role built for someone who is fluent with modern tools, including AI, and eager to grow into a broader analytics or finance career. This is a high-visibility seat: your work will inform decisions made by department leaders, the executive team, and our board and investors. You will not be expected to know everything on day one, but you will be expected to be curious, precise, and quick to learn. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Query our cloud data lake using SQL and AI-assisted tooling to answer business questions and produce the inputs behind recurring reporting. Build and maintain recurring reports and dashboards, KPI trackers, operational metrics, and finance and business performance views, in the company's business intelligence platform. Embed AI into our reporting processes, using tools such as Claude and Copilot to automate data preparation, accelerate analysis, and build AI-assisted outputs into how reports are produced and delivered. Own data integrity across your reporting: reconcile figures to source systems, validate them against defined business rules, and proactively surface and resolve discrepancies before anything reaches a stakeholder. Deliver business insight and data clarity, translating stakeholder questions across departments into well-scoped analysis, and presenting results in a way that makes the story in the data clear and actionable. Establish and maintain documentation for data definitions, report logic, and reporting processes, ensuring consistency, transparency, and continuity across the analytics function. Help build a scalable reporting and data infrastructure, standardizing datasets, automating manual steps, and extending the company's unified data layer so reporting can grow without adding headcount. Partner with leaders across the business to understand their reporting needs and turn them into dashboards and reports they use. Collaborate with data engineering on schema changes, new data sources, and pipeline issues that affect downstream reporting. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Rigor: Strong commitment to data integrity, careful, detail-oriented, and skeptical of your own numbers until they tie out to source. Communication: Able to explain findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders (ELT and Board level) in writing and in conversation. Curiosity & Ownership: Digs into why a number looks off instead of taking it at face value, and proactively flags or fixes reporting gaps, inefficiencies, and stale processes rather than waiting to be asked. Adaptability: Picks up new tools quickly without getting attached to a specific platform, juggles multiple stakeholder requests at once, and favors the simplest report that answers the question over the most complex one. Required Technical Skills Reporting: Hands-on experience building and maintaining recurring reports or dashboards in a modern business intelligence platform. We are tool-agnostic; transferable skills matter more than any specific product. SQL: Working proficiency in SQL, including joins, aggregations, and filtering across multiple tables; comfortable querying a cloud data warehouse or data lake. Excel: Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and clean, well-structured workbooks. AI: Practical experience using AI tools in a data or reporting context, and the ability to apply them to automate and improve analytics work. Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with Python or R for data manipulation. Understanding of finance or FP&A concepts (budgets, actuals, variance, KPIs). Experience with version control (Git) or dbt / data-transformation tooling. Exposure to a B2C and/or B2B subscription or e-commerce business. Data visualization or design sense, with an eye for building dashboards that are clean and readable, not just functional. Direct experience working directly in a cloud data warehouse or data lake environment. Supervisory Responsibility This position does not supervise the work of others. Internal and External Interaction This position interacts regularly with FP&A, Business Operations, Data Engineering, and leaders across the organization. Reporting and analysis produced by this role may also support the executive team, Board, and investors. Physical Requirements The physical demands of this position are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. What Success Looks Like Recurring reports and dashboards are accurate, reliable, and delivered on time. Data consistently reconciles to source systems, with discrepancies identified and resolved before reaching stakeholders. Leaders across the business have clear, actionable reporting that helps them make better decisions. Manual reporting processes become more scalable and repeatable through automation and standardization. Reporting definitions, logic, and processes are clearly documented and consistently applied. AI tools are effectively incorporated into reporting and analytics processes to improve efficiency and accelerate analysis. Business questions are translated into clear, well-scoped analysis that communicates the story behind the data. Reporting gaps, inefficiencies, and data issues are proactively identified and addressed. Strong partnerships are built with FP&A, Data Engineering, and leaders across the business. The role continues to develop broader analytics, business intelligence, and finance capabilities over time. nternal and external interaction: This position interacts with peers both in and out of the department and their immediate manager on a regular basis. They may interact with customers and vendors directly in escalation or support situations in a large geographical area. They will interact with managers in other departments What We Offer: Employment benefits granted upon hire date: Tuition reimbursement, subject to approval Paid company holidays (9 days off per year) Flexible Time Off (FTO), as described in the employee handbook Remote and collaborative work environment Employment benefits granted the first of the month following 30 days of employment include: Voluntary participation in Career Certified’s medical, dental, and vision plans, as well as supplemental insurance options Voluntary participation in Career Certified’s 401k plan Career Certified is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where employees can thrive and contribute to organizational success. CareTalk Health About CareTalk Health CareTalk Health is a national virtual medical practice specializing in Clinical Process Outsourcing (CPO). We partner with healthcare organizations to build and manage patient and member populations, delivering care by video across the states we serve and scheduling approximately 20,000 patient visits per month. (NO built-in mics) Internet Speed: Meet minimum internet speed requirements (100 MBPS download speed and 50 MBPS upload speed). Must have an ethernet cable connecting computer directly into router. jobs.ashbyhq.com:reframesystems/e32a6439.text: ABOUT US Reframe Systems is a Physical AI and robotics company on a mission to make high-performance housing attainable and abundant in the communities where people want to live. Through our vertically integrated delivery model and highly automated microfactories, we deliver climate-resilient homes and buildings with greater speed and predictability than traditional construction. Our volumetric modular buildings are produced in our Andover, MA microfactory, with a growing pipeline across North America and a new microfactory on the way. We are building a system that balances repeatability with site-responsive design, enabling homes adaptable to each site, community, and customer need. Our cross-disciplinary team brings together architecture, robotics, design engineering, software, factory operations, and field delivery to change how housing gets delivered. We’re reimagining the future of housing through a smarter and more sustainable system that empowers people to live better. Come build it with us. THE ROLE As our Financial Analyst, you will serve as a core engine for Reframe’s FP&A, operational finance, and strategic planning. You won't just be tracking numbers—you will help define the unit economics of our modular microfactories, track Bill of Materials (BOM) cost reductions, and build financial visibility as we scale from 1 → 10. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for a data-driven finance professional who thrives in a fast-paced hardware/manufacturing startup environment. WHAT YOU'LL OWN 1. FP&A & Corporate Financial Modeling - Financial Planning & Budgeting: Own and maintain the company’s 3-statement financial model, rolling forecasts, and annual budgeting process. - Variance Analysis: Track monthly and quarterly actuals vs. budget (BvA), analyzing key drivers behind revenue, operating expenses, and capex. - Executive & Board Reporting: Prepare financial packages, dashboards, and strategic decks for leadership and board meetings. 2. Factory Ops & Unit Economics - Cost Accounting & BOM Analysis: Partner with Supply Chain and Manufacturing Engineering to model Bill of Materials (BOM) costs, direct labor rates, and factory overhead absorption. - Microfactory Unit Economics: Help analyze and refine the business model for individual microfactories (payback periods, throughput capacity, asset utilization, and gross margin optimization). - Capital Allocation: Build ROI models for factory equipment purchases, robotics automation investments, and facility expansion (e.g., FAB1). 3. jobs.ashbyhq.com:prior-labs/9d27597d-c54.text: WHO WE ARE Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables. We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-024-08328-6 cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics https://www.oxcan.org/news/prior-labs-and-oxford-cancer-analytics-partner-to-advance-liquid-biopsy-and-clinical-decision-making-in-lung-disease to preventing train failures with Hitachi https://siliconangle.com/2025/12/01/prior-labs-debuts-tabular-ai-foundation-model-scales-10-million-rows/. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level. We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ https://priorlabs.ai/about with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter https://www.linkedin.com/in/frank-hutter-9190b24b/, Noah Hollmann https://www.linkedin.com/in/noah-hollmann-668b9010b/, and Sauraj Gambhir https://www.linkedin.com/in/sauraj-g/, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun. In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP https://priorlabs.ai/blog-posts/priorlabs-sap as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years. The role Most enterprises will never call our API directly. They will meet TabPFN inside the platforms they already run: SAP, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Databricks, or their own cloud. How well that works, how fast each release arrives there, and which platforms come next is the job of our Technical Product Manager for Integrations. You take each model release from handover to live across every channel, working with the engineers who build the model and the partner teams who host it. Inside SAP you carry the product side of TabPFN across its platforms, from AI Core to SAP Analytics Cloud, and you help build the integration engineering team that will work with you. Several decisions are yours to bring to the table: which announced channels we build next, what a marketplace listing should cost, how support for all of this works. You work directly with our product team, our engineers and the founders, and you report to the CTO. This suits someone who enjoys landing things on a date as much as deciding what to build, and who still likes being close to the code. What you'll do - Take every model release live across SAP, the cloud marketplaces and customer environments, on a plan you build with product and engineering. - Be the technical counterpart for the partner teams that host TabPFN, from SAP's platform teams to the hyperscaler marketplaces. - Shape how TabPFN shows up inside SAP's stack and what the integration engineering team builds first. - Bring the open channel decisions to the founders with a recommendation, and stay hands-on: listings, docs, smoke tests, a PR when it is faster than asking. What we're looking for - Two or more years as product manager for a platform or integration surface: a product that ships into partners' platforms, or that other companies build on. - You have shipped through gates you did not control, landed multi-team releases on dates, and made a large enterprise's process work for a small, fast team. - You started as an engineer and never fully stopped: you read code, logs and scan reports without a translator. - You are in Berlin or ready to relocate; Freiburg or New York can work. What sets you apart - You have shipped into an SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft or Oracle ecosystem, or know the cloud marketplaces from the inside. - You have deployed machine learning models and know what GPUs cost. - You have worked at a startup, and you use AI tools to take real work off your plate. LIFE AT PRIOR LABS You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right. Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together. OUR COMMITMENTS The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are. We care about how your data is handled - see our Recruiting Data Privacy https://priorlabs.ai/recruiting-data-privacy page

jobs.ashbyhq.com:checkly/8a10b860-5b29-4.text: (Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3) The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken. They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place. Thousands https://www.checklyhq.com/customers/ of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai http://resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. Now we need a PM who wants to take that further, in a market being rewritten in real time. Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. Nobody has really figured out what reliability means for this kind of software yet. That's the problem you'd own. WHAT YOU'LL DO As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for empowering developers and designers to solve customer problems. You will work directly with our SVP Product Engineering Daniel https://www.linkedin.com/in/daniel-paulus-checkly/. You will: - Shape company and product strategy alongside our SVP of Product Engineering. It's a genuine partnership: you'll develop the vision for where Checkly goes next, decide where we play in the AI testing, monitoring, and observability landscape and where we don't, and turn that into a direction. You build the strategy with us, not execute someone else's. - Shape Checkly's point of view on reliability in an AI-native world: how teams monitor AI-generated code, agent-driven workflows, and LLM-backed features - Lead initiatives across Product Engineering, Sales and Marketing, and represent Checkly directly to customers and in developer communities. - Live in the product and the problem. Empathy for DevOps, SRE and Platform Engineering isn't a line item. It's the job. - You ship with AI where it helps and know when not to. You don't just talk about it. WHAT YOU SHOULD HAVE - You've built software before this. You're an ex-engineer, ex-founder, or ex-solutions engineer who has written real code and shipped real things, and now you want to own the product. This one's non-negotiable: you should be able to reason about APIs, MCPs, CLIs, and how systems fit together without a translator. - You've worked in a startup, not just a big company. You're comfortable with ambiguity, small teams, and owning outcomes end to end. You don't need a big-company machine around you to be effective. - You've built technical products, ideally developer tools. Adjacent technical products count. Experience in monitoring or observability is a nice-to-have, not a requirement. - New to the PM title? That's fine. If you're coming from a founding or solutions-engineering seat and want to go all-in on product, we want to hear from you. - You're technical enough to be dangerous with AI tooling. You can prototype in code, throw together a mock, or pressure-test technical viability yourself when it moves things forward. - FULLY remote role, within the UTC-3 to UTC+3 time zones. Need to be able to travel to (other) European countries without having to wait for a visa appointment. WHAT YOU WILL HATE ABOUT US We would rather tell you now than have you find out in month two. - We use AI for everything, and we mean everything. AI skepticism is not a thing here. If you have the slightest hesitation about working with AI every day, this is not the place for you, and that is completely fine. - We write more than we talk. We are async-first, so a lot of decisions happen in documents and threads, not meetings. If you do your best thinking out loud in a room full of people, you will miss it here. - We are lean, so you own the boring parts too. There is no PM ops layer to delegate the unglamorous work to. You will do strategy one hour and clean up a messy spec the next. - We ship constantly and change our minds. Priorities move as we learn from customers. If you need long, stable planning cycles, this will feel chaotic. - Customer signals come first, and most of the time they beat your gut. We build what customers actually want, not the clever thing we dreamed up. Earn it by making customers happy, and then there is room for the moonshots. jobs.ashbyhq.com:oscilar/24233649-65d0-4.text: Shape the future of trust in the age of AI At Oscilar, we're building the most advanced AI Risk Decisioning™ Platform. Banks, fintechs, and digitally native organizations rely on us to manage their fraud, credit, and compliance risk with the power of AI. If you're passionate about solving complex problems and making the internet safer for everyone, this is your place https://oscilar.com/careers. WHY JOIN US: - Mission-driven teams: Work alongside industry veterans from Meta, Uber, Citi, and Confluent, all united by a shared goal to make the digital world safer. - Ownership and impact: We believe in extreme ownership. You'll be empowered to take responsibility, move fast, and make decisions that drive our mission forward. - Innovate at the cutting edge: Your work will shape how modern finance detects fraud and manages risk. THE ROLE: AML operations teams are making high-stakes decisions on bad tooling. False positive rates hitting 90–95%. SAR narratives written by hand. Alert queues backlogged for days. Investigation workflows duct-taped across a transaction monitoring system, a case management tool, and a spreadsheet no one owns. AI has gotten good enough to fix most of this - but compliance teams don't trust it yet, and most AI vendors don't understand AML well enough to earn that trust. You will own the product that earns it. At Oscilar, you'll have full product ownership of our AML and financial crimes suite: transaction monitoring, KYC/KYB, screening, case management, SAR filing, and the AI agents that are beginning to augment and automate the investigation workflow itself. This is not a handed-down playbook. You are writing it. WHAT YOU'LL OWN: - Transaction Monitoring. The rules engine and ML model layer that generates alerts - scenario design, threshold calibration, typology coverage, backtesting against historical transaction data. You'll define what the system flags, why, and how those decisions evolve as customer behavior and fraud typologies shift. You understand the difference between a rules-based velocity check and a graph-based network detection model, and you have opinions on when each is right. - KYC / KYB. Onboarding risk workflows: identity verification, document checks, beneficial ownership, ongoing monitoring triggers, and risk re-scoring. You know the data sources that power these decisions - bureau data, device signals, open banking, registry data - and how to orchestrate them dynamically based on risk tier rather than applying a one-size waterfall. - Screening. Sanctions (OFAC, UN, EU), PEPs, adverse media, and negative news. You understand the matching problem - why fuzzy matching on names produces the false positive rates it does, and what it takes to make screening defensible to an examiner without generating alert volumes that bury the ops team. - SAR Filing & Regulatory Reporting. FinCEN SAR workflow end-to-end: narrative generation, supporting documentation, filing status, audit trail. You've seen what regulators look for in an MRA and you build product that holds up under that scrutiny. - AML Data Strategy. The data model that powers all of the above: transaction graphs, entity resolution, behavioral baselines, consortium signals, model feature pipelines. You can speak fluently to a data engineer about what data the models need and why, and to a compliance officer about what the model's output means and how it was derived. HOW YOU'LL WORK: - You are an AI-native PM. You use AI tools throughout your entire workflow — not as a novelty, but as a force multiplier that lets you do in a day what used to take a week. - For discovery: You use AI to synthesize call transcripts, cluster themes across interviews, scan regulatory guidance and examiner findings, and surface competitive product gaps faster than any manual process. You come into customer conversations already knowing what the literature says - so you can spend the time extracting what the literature doesn't. - For building: You use AI to generate first-draft PRDs, stress-test your own specs, write and iterate on user stories, prototype UI flows, and pressure-test edge cases before engineering touches them. Your specs are tighter and your stakeholder review cycles are shorter as a result. - For design: You use AI to explore multiple UX directions quickly and give the design team a sharper brief. You're not a designer - but you use AI tools well enough that you show up with something specific rather than a blank page. - For analysis: You use AI to query product and operational data, interpret model outputs, and build the evidence base for roadmap decisions. You don't wait for a data analyst to unblock you. This is how we build. If you've already made AI tools a core part of your workflow, you'll find us a natural fit. REQUIREMENTS: - Full-stack AML product depth. You've shipped product across at least two of the five areas above - in production, with real users, under real regulatory scrutiny. You've sat in a room where an examiner asked a question about your system and understood exactly what was at stake. You know what a BSA officer worries about before an exam, and you build product that addresses it. - AML strategy knowledge. You understand how AML programs are designed and calibrated, not just executed. You know why scenario thresholds drift over time and how to fix it. You know the difference between a structuring typology and a layering typology and have an opinion on which detection approach fits each. You understand model drift, backtesting methodology, and what a model validation report covers. You can engage a Chief Compliance Officer on their AML program design and add something to the conversation - not just listen. - Technical and data fluency. Your engineers trust your specs. You can read a data schema, write a query to validate a hypothesis, and spot when an ML model is being misapplied. You understand the explainability problem in AI-assisted compliance decisions - not as an abstract concern, but as a concrete product constraint - and you have a position on how to solve it. - Regulatory literacy. BSA, FinCEN, OFAC, FATF. You understand what examiners are looking for, what triggers an MRA, and how to build a defensible audit trail. You've worked in an environment where regulatory guidance was unclear, evolving, or in conflict with shipping speed - and you made the call anyway. - Bias toward speed. You use AI tools to move faster, test sooner, and learn earlier. You do in a week what takes a month elsewhere. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE: 30 days: You've run discovery with at least 5 AML/compliance buyers - BSA officers, heads of financial crimes, CCOs - and produced a written synthesis that surfaces at least one insight we didn't already have. You've reviewed our current AML product surface and identified the two biggest gaps relative to what buyers actually need. 60 days: You've delivered one complete PRD - spec'd, reviewed by engineering, AML SME's and product, and ready to build. You have a clear point of view on the SAR narrative automation problem: what to build, what not to build, and why. You've pressure-tested it with at least two practitioners who aren't already sold on it. 90 days: You're already the PM on calls with CCO prospects. You have a 12-month AML roadmap with clear prioritization rationale. And you've shipped at least one thing to production. BENEFITS - Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages, including a 401k plan - Flexibility: Remote-first culture — work from anywhere - Health: 100% Employer covered comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance with a top tier plan for you and your dependents (US) - Balance: Unlimited PTO policy - Technical: AI First company; both Co-Founders are engineers at heart; and over 50% of the company is Engineering and Product - Culture: Family-Friendly environment; Regular team events and offsites - Development: Unparalleled learning and professional development opportunities - Impact: Making the internet safer by protecting online transactions

About the role As a Business Systems Analyst on Anthropic's BizTech team, you'll play a crucial role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You'll translate complex business requirements into technical specifications and architectural decisions, ensuring engineering teams build solutions that scale with our rapid growth. You'll work closely with stakeholders across the organization to understand their requirements, configure systems, and ensure our business technology ecosystem operates efficiently and effectively. This role combines analytical thinking with technical expertise to design, implement, and maintain systems that drive operational excellence. You'll be responsible for analyzing business processes, gathering requirements, and translating them into technical solutions. As we continue to scale rapidly, you'll help ensure our systems and processes evolve to meet the growing demands of our organization while maintaining the high standards of efficiency and reliability that Anthropic requires. permissions, workflows, and integrations Manage technical vendor evaluation for business applications, including contract negotiations, service level agreements, and ongoing vendor performance assessment Create and maintain comprehensive system documentation, including process flows, user guides, configuration specifications, and technical documentation Lead knowledge management initiatives to ensure institutional knowledge is captured, organized, and accessible to all team members Own technical risk assessment and mitigation strategies Analyze current business processes and identify opportunities for automation and optimization Act as a liaison between technical teams and business users, translating complex technical concepts into user-friendly language Conduct system testing, validation, and user acceptance testing for new implementations and updates Provide ongoing support and training to end-users across the organization Monitor system performance and usage metrics to identify areas for improvement Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure business systems integrate seamlessly with other platforms Stay current with emerging technologies and industry best practices in business systems management You may be a good fit if you: Have 5+ years of experience as a Business Systems Analyst or similar role in a technology-focused environment Possess strong managing vendor relationships and evaluating technology solutions Are an effective communicator who can bridge the gap between technical and non-technical stakeholders Thrive in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and requirements Have experience with API integrations and iPaaS solutions Have a passion for process improvement and automation Are proactive and self-directed systems or project management Have experience with business intelligence and reporting tools Have worked in high-growth startup environments Have knowledge of ITIL or other IT service management frameworks Have experience implementing knowledge management systems or intranets Deadline to apply: None. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. About the role We launch new products, models and pricing often, and each launch has to work in our systems on day one. A seller needs to be able to quote it, Deal Desk needs to be able to approve it, billing needs to charge for it correctly, and Finance needs to report on it. This role owns how a launch gets into our quote-to-cash systems, from the first pricing conversation to the first invoice. We are looking for someone who treats every launch as a change across many systems. You will join launch planning early, work out what has to change across catalog, quoting, contracts, billing, tax and reporting, and get all of it ready before the launch date. You will build a good part of the Salesforce work yourself and partner with our Salesforce developers and Billing Engineering on the rest. jobs.ashbyhq.com:middesk/a352d80e-5640-4.text: ABOUT MIDDESK: Middesk is building the data and intelligence infrastructure that helps businesses work together with confidence. We started by creating a comprehensive platform for understanding businesses, bringing together authoritative and proprietary data to help customers verify business identities, onboard customers faster, and manage risk throughout the customer lifecycle. Today, Middesk is used by more than 700 banks and fintechs, and in 2025 we verified more than 7 million companies. We've also expanded beyond business verification to help companies form, register, manage, and maintain their businesses, supporting more than 50,000 companies in setting up over 100,000 accounts required to hire employees, run payroll, and stay compliant. Middesk came out of Y Combinator, and is backed by Sequoia Capital, Accel, Insight Partners, and Canapi. We're proud to be named on the Forbes Fintech 50 and Best Startup Employers lists. THE ROLE: We’re hiring a Group Product Manager to join our Entity Management team, reporting to the Head of Product. You’ll lead a small team of Product Managers and own a growing suite of products that help companies establish, manage, and maintain their business entities and payroll tax obligations. Today, that includes: - Payroll Tax Registration Suite: Helping companies register, manage, and stay compliant with state payroll tax accounts throughout the full lifecycle. - Business Formations: Helping companies form new business entities and manage the workflows required to get them up and running. Our flagship product, State Payroll Tax Registration, established Middesk as a critical infrastructure partner for payroll providers like Gusto, Rippling, and Deel, helping their customers hire employees, run payroll, and stay compliant across the U.S.. The team is now building on that foundation in a few important ways: expanding beyond initial registration to support the full lifecycle of payroll tax account management, hardening and improving the platform to support its next horizon of scale, and bringing an entirely new Business Formations product suite to market. You’ll be leading across products at very different stages of maturity. Some have meaningful scale and require continued investment in reliability, automation, operational efficiency, and platform capabilities. Others have only recently launched and require rapid iteration, customer discovery, and product-market fit work. Across the suite, we’re increasingly automating complex, multi-step compliance workflows through agentic systems that can act on behalf of our customers. You’ll lead a small product team while staying close to the work yourself. You’ll help set priorities and coach PMs, while also owning the day-to-day execution of core parts of the roadmap. You’ll work directly with Engineering to shape requirements and ship on a fast, iterative cadence, talk with customers to validate problems and test solutions, and partner with leaders across Go-to-Market and Operations to grow these products through embedded partner distribution. Location We follow a hybrid work model, and for this role, there is an expectation of 2-3 days per week in our NYC office. Candidates should be based within a commutable distance, as we believe in the value of in-person collaboration and building strong team connections while also supporting flexibility where possible. What You'll Do: - Lead a small product team while staying hands-on. Coach PMs, set priorities, and personally own meaningful parts of the roadmap from discovery through launch. - Own the health of our flagship products, balancing reliability, efficiency, and new capabilities against metrics like SLA performance, retention, automation, and margins. - Harden Payroll Tax Registration for its next stage of scale, improving reliability, reducing manual work, and strengthening the platform underneath it. - Build and scale emerging products, including the broader payroll suite and Business Formations, from early launch through product-market fit. - Use agentic workflows to automate complex compliance work, designing systems that safely reduce manual effort and improve over time. - Stay close to customers and partners to identify problems, validate solutions, and shape the roadmap. - Expand into new jurisdictions, capabilities, and distribution channels to grow the reach of the product suite. - Support existing customers, helping resolve product issues and turning recurring pain points into product improvements. - Partner tightly across Engineering, Operations, Legal/Compliance, and Go-to-Market to turn complex requirements into products that ship. What We’re Looking For: - 5-7+ years of product management experience building and scaling B2B SaaS, automation, or complex workflow products. - Experience building B2B products delivered through APIs or embedded partner ecosystems. - A track record of owning products across different stages of maturity, from scaling established, revenue-generating products to developing and validating emerging product bets. - Experience managing and developing a small team, while remaining comfortable staying close to the work and executing directly when needed. - Strong systems and operational thinking, with an instinct for using metrics like completion rates, cost per action, automation rates, human intervention, and SLA performance to drive decisions. - Comfort operating cross-functionally across Engineering, Operations, Legal/Compliance, and Go-to-Market teams. Nice to Have: - Domain expertise in compliance, regulatory operations, payroll, fintech, or legal tech, with the credibility to challenge existing processes and translate complex regulatory requirements into scalable product and automation workflows. - Experience operating in a high-growth startup environment, ideally at the Series B or C stage, with comfort moving quickly and iterating through ambiguity.

greenhouse:6178855004.text: Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for an Product Manager to join our New Product Introduction team, focused on nuclear reactor products. We are looking to fill this position immediately. Position Description Oklo’s Product Managers are responsible for identifying, defining, developing, and deploying new products that advance the company’s mission. These products may involve new applications of Oklo’s technology, capabilities incorporated into future deployments, or offerings that create additional value for customers and stakeholders. The Product Manager works across engineering, commercial, operations, licensing, manufacturing, supply chain, and other functions to translate promising ideas into well-defined, deployable products. This role establishes the product vision, identifies customer and business needs, defines requirements and success criteria, and guides the product through technical development and deployment. This is a highly technical product role. The Product Manager must be able to understand complex engineered systems, work closely with technical teams, and make thoughtful tradeoffs among performance, cost, schedule, risk, manufacturability, licensing, and customer value. Successful candidates may come from a product management background with strong engineering experience or may be engineers who are excited to take broader ownership of product strategy and deployment. Specific responsibilities may include: Identifying and evaluating opportunities for products, capabilities, and applications of Oklo nuclear reactor technology. Developing clear product visions, value propositions, business cases, and deployment strategies. Working with customers, partners, commercial teams, and internal stakeholders to understand needs and translate them into actionable product requirements. Partnering closely with engineering teams to define product functionality, technical requirements, interfaces, performance objectives, and acceptance criteria. Building and maintaining product roadmaps that connect technical development with commercial opportunities and deployment objectives. Guiding reactor technology products from early concept and feasibility assessment through design, development, validation, and deployment. Establishing appropriate product development plans, decision points, maturity criteria, and measures of success. Leading cross-functional trade studies and decisions involving technical performance, safety, cost, schedule, licensing, manufacturability, operability, and commercial value. Ensuring development work is appropriately sized and focused on resolving the most important product risks and uncertainties. Coordinating across engineering, licensing, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, operations, finance, and commercial teams to maintain alignment and execution. Identifying reactor technology product risks, dependencies, and critical decisions and ensuring they are clearly owned and resolved. Communicating reactor technology product priorities, technical considerations, decisions, and progress to company leadership and other stakeholders. Supporting design reviews, customer engagements, partner discussions, procurement activities, and deployment planning. Developing a strong understanding of the technical and regulatory environment affecting the product and incorporating relevant constraints into reactor product strategy. Gathering feedback from testing, deployment, operations, customers, and partners to guide continued product improvement. Establishing clear reactor technology product ownership and maintaining accountability for overall product outcomes throughout the product lifecycle. Minimum Qualifications: 5+ years of experience in product management, engineering, systems engineering, technical program management, or a similar role developing complex technical products. Specific experience with nuclear reactor technology in areas such as design, safety, licensing, construction, or operations. An engineering degree or equivalent experience working directly with engineered systems and technical development teams. Demonstrated experience translating customer, business, or operational needs into product requirements and development priorities. Experience guiding technical work from early-stage concepts toward validated, deployable solutions. Ability to understand complex technical information and make informed tradeoffs involving performance, cost, schedule, risk, and customer value. Experience coordinating work and decisions across multiple technical and non-technical functions. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Proven ability to operate independently in ambiguous, fast-moving environments. Bonus Qualifications: Experience developing hardware, energy systems, industrial equipment, or other complex physical products. Experience as a practicing engineer or technical lead. Experience with product development in regulated industries such as nuclear energy, aerospace, medical devices, or advanced manufacturing. Experience developing business cases, product roadmaps, technical requirements, or deployment strategies. Experience working with customers, commercial partners, vendors, or government stakeholders. Familiarity with isotope production, nuclear fuel, advanced manufacturing, or related technologies. Experience in a startup or rapidly scaling organization. Competencies Technical & Role-Specific Competencies Strong technical judgment and the ability to understand complex engineered systems. Ability to connect customer and business needs with feasible technical solutions. Experience defining product requirements, development priorities, success criteria, and product roadmaps. Strong structured problem-solving skills; able to break ambiguous opportunities into clear questions, workstreams, decisions, and deliverables. Ability to evaluate and communicate tradeoffs among technical performance, safety, cost, schedule, licensing, manufacturability, operability, and commercial value. Ability to guide products through multiple stages of maturity, from early opportunity identification and feasibility assessment through development and deployment. Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to build alignment without relying on direct authority. Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to engineering teams, company leadership, customers, partners, and other stakeholders. Sound judgment regarding when additional analysis is necessary and when a product is sufficiently mature to proceed. Ability to maintain focus on overall product outcomes while engaging deeply enough in technical details to support effective decisions. Ways You Work Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities across teams. Clear, concise written and verbal communicator. Proactive, low-ego leader who takes ownership and follows through. Comfortable navigating ambiguity and iterating as priorities evolve. Curious and eager to develop a strong understanding of new technologies, markets, and customer needs. Able to move comfortably between product strategy, technical detail, and execution planning. Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment. Who you are: A startup person : You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that. Motivated : You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals. A team-player : Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team. An excellent communicator : We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator. Creative : Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day. Detail-oriented : This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward. About Oklo travel requirements: Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA. About Oklo compensation: Salary: $140,000-$200,000 Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits. This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible. About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories. #CHOP: Oklo’s Values Collaboration : We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes. Humility : We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition. Ownership : We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy. Pathfinding : We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity. Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws. Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address. All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process. If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

jobs.lever.co:loftorbital/13ce3ff5-a745-.text:
Wanna join the adventure? Loft's AI for Space group is building the stack that runs real machine learning in orbit; turning raw sensor data into decisions on the satellite itself, so insight reaches the customer in minutes instead of hours. The AI Engineering team is where models meet the spacecraft. We own the full path from a partner's trained model to something that actually runs — fast — on flight hardware: compiling ONNX models into optimized engines for each accelerator, the Space Inference Engine and its execution providers, the SDK that packages models for flight, and the perf tooling that proves a model fits its power, thermal, and latency budget before it ever leaves the ground. As we open the platform to a growing roster of defense and Earth-observation partners, the team's scope and the range of silicon we target are expanding fast. As our ML Runtime Engineer, you'll own model compilation and the performance tooling behind it. We're looking for someone scrappy — the kind of engineer who takes an unfamiliar model and an unforgiving power budget, digs into the graph, and gets it running on real hardware without waiting for the path to be handed to them. You'll move between model compilation, runtime internals, quantization, and hardware-in-the-loop CI, sometimes in the same afternoon. *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications.
